headline: PIC to Acquire Remaining Stake in Gateway Real Estate for R2.6 Billion
summary: South Africa's Public Investment Corporation (PIC) plans to acquire the remaining 48.08% stake in Gateway, whose portfolio includes US embassies and data centres, in a R2.6 billion deal.
why: State pension fund investments in high-security real estate portfolios generate stable long-term yields for public sector beneficiaries.

impacts.name: Gateway Real Estate Africa
impacts.why: A full buyout by a major institutional investor provides capital and ownership consolidation.
